Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Holder National Investment Services Upped B & G Foods (BGS) Stake; New Vernon Capital Holdings Ii Has Boosted Its Holding in Icici Bk LTD (IBN) by $881,544 as Stock Value Rose 
March 1, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
National Investment Services Inc increased its stake in B & G Foods (BGS) by 88.25% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. National Investment Services Inc bought 9,973 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.06% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 21,274 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $678,000, up from 11,301 at the end of the previous reported quarter. National Investment Services Inc who had been investing in B & G Foods for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.85B market cap company. The stock increased 0.54% or $0.149 during the last trading session, reaching $27.849. About 576,103 shares traded. B&G Foods, Inc. (NYSE:BGS) has declined 7.13% since March 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.83% the S&P500. 
New Vernon Capital Holdings Ii Llc increased its stake in Icici Bk Ltd (IBN) by 24.43% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. New Vernon Capital Holdings Ii Llc bought 110,193 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.25% with the market. The hedge fund held 561,193 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $4.80 million, up from 451,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New Vernon Capital Holdings Ii Llc who had been investing in Icici Bk Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $30.39 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.84% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $9.42. About 3.09 million shares traded. ICICI Bank Limited (NYSE:IBN) has risen 45.32% since March 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.62% the S&P500. 
National Investment Services Inc, which manages about $4.22B and $97.34M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5,153 shares to 8,946 shares, valued at $1.38 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. 
Among 12 analysts covering B&G Foods ( NYSE:BGS ), 6 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. B&G Foods had 37 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Buckingham Research upgraded the shares of BGS in report on Wednesday, August 23 to “Buy” rating. The stock has “Hold” rating by Credit Suisse on Monday, May 29. The rating was maintained by Buckingham Research with “Neutral” on Friday, August 4. The stock of B&G Foods, Inc. (NYSE:BGS) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, April 21 by RBC Capital Markets. The rating was upgraded by Zacks on Thursday, August 27 to “Sell”. DA Davidson upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Friday, April 29 report. William Blair maintained B&G Foods, Inc. (NYSE:BGS) on Friday, September 4 with “Outperform” rating. The rating was initiated by Buckingham Research on Monday, October 19 with “Neutral”. DA Davidson initiated the shares of BGS in report on Friday, December 11 with “Neutral” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Stephens on Wednesday, November 1. 
Among 7 analysts covering ICICI Bank ( NYSE:IBN ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. ICICI Bank had 11 analyst reports since August 19, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Goldman Sachs upgraded ICICI Bank Limited (NYSE:IBN) on Monday, October 24 to “Buy” rating. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, May 3 by Goldman Sachs. On Thursday, April 21 the stock rating was upgraded by Credit Suisse to “Outperform”. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, August 26 by Standpoint Research. The rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs to “Buy” on Monday, September 14. The rating was upgraded by Jefferies to “Buy” on Monday, October 30. The firm has “Sell” rating by Zacks given on Tuesday, August 25. The stock of ICICI Bank Limited (NYSE:IBN) earned “Buy” rating by UBS on Friday, October 21. On Thursday, September 3 the stock rating was upgraded by Zacks to “Hold”. Morgan Stanley initiated the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, January 16 report.   Louis Casey
